item.title: Kakunodate Kabazaiku: 200-Year Cherry Bark Craft — Guide
item.description: Kakunodate’s 200-year-old craft tradition of kabazaiku uses cherry tree bark to create lustrous, durable containers, tea canisters and accessories. The bark is peeled, layered and polished to a warm honey-brown sheen — a uniquely Akita art form born from the samurai district’s need for a secondary income. Several workshops in the samurai quarter welcome visitors to watch artisans at work. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Kakunodate, Senboku, Akita Hours Workshops ~9:00–17:00 Admission Free to browse; pieces vary Time needed 45 min–1.
